title: Agreement Brand Rates on Change Fees for Corporate Tickets
content:
**Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — brand rates on change fees for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The change fee of a voluntary, standard exchange is multiplied by the **brand rate**, which follows the agreement's discount-eligible fare brands. The rate acts on the unrounded fee; the fee is rounded to the cent only at the end.

| Ticket | Brand rate |
|---|---|
| Names an active agreement, and its fare brand is one the agreement discounts | 0.9 (eligible brand rate) |
| Names an active agreement, and its fare brand is one the agreement does not discount | 0.97 (other brand rate) |
| Any other ticket | 1 |

The discount-eligible fare brands are the official fare brand names listed by the agreement's tier in Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements; the agreement's status is read from its record; the ticket's fare brand is the one recorded on the ticket.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Agreement status | Agreement discounts the ticket's fare brand | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Yes (for example Crestline Main Cabin listed) | 0.9 |
| Active | No | 0.97 |
| Not active | Yes | 1 |
| No agreement named | — | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A fee of 110 dollars at a brand rate of 0.97 becomes 106.70 dollars.
